_note: Texts that invite you to do something. Accepting uses a time slot. from: a friend id, 'mum', 'gran' or 'squad'. venue: opens that casino venue instead (gran / lee). minAge optional. {a} = a teammate's surname.

deano.text: mate. MATE. dog track tonight. i've got a system
deano.label: Go to the dogs with Deano
deano.result: Deano's system involves picking dogs by how kind their eyes look. You lose £20. Best night of the month.

deano.text: five-a-side at the leisure centre, we're one short and Gaz has done his ankle again
deano.label: Play five-a-side
deano.result: You score eleven. A dad in a Leeds shirt calls you a ringer. He's right.

deano.text: need a hand moving a sofa. it's not stolen. it's 'liberated'
deano.label: Help Deano with the sofa
deano.result: The sofa doesn't fit up his stairs. It now lives in his front garden. He calls it 'outdoor living'.

deano.text: quiz night at the Red Lion. we need someone who knows things. i'll settle for you
deano.label: Go to the pub quiz
deano.result: You come third. Deano answers 'Nelson Mandela' to every question in the music round. Two are correct.

deano.text: pitching my new business to some investors (my uncle). need you there for credibility
deano.label: Back Deano's pitch
deano.result: The business is 'Uber, but for ladders'. Uncle Clive invests £40. Deano cries.

deano.text: fish and chips on the seafront? my treat. (you're paying)
deano.label: Get chips with Deano
deano.result: A seagull takes a whole sausage out of Deano's hand. He considers it a personal attack.

shaz.text: PARTY. MINE. SATURDAY. THEME IS 'ICONIC DUOS'. you're ant OR dec, you choose
shaz.label: Go to Shaz's party
shaz.result: The police come round at 1am. Shaz invites them in. One of them does a speech.

shaz.text: karaoke tonight!! i've already put you down for Mr Brightside, no backing out
shaz.label: Do karaoke with Shaz
shaz.result: You murder Mr Brightside. Someone films it. It's quite popular, in a bad way.

shaz.text: need a plus one for my cousin's wedding, the ex will be there, act rich
shaz.label: Be Shaz's plus one
shaz.result: You act rich. You are, slightly, rich. The ex leaves early. Shaz says it was 'the best day of her life'.

shaz.text: spin class at 7. it's like a party but you can't leave
shaz.label: Do spin class with Shaz
shaz.result: The instructor shouts at you by name. Shaz has told her who you are. Your legs file a complaint.

shaz.text: help me pick an outfit?? i've narrowed it down to 41
shaz.label: Help Shaz shop
shaz.result: Five hours. She buys the first one. Of course she does.

lee.text: cards. mine. thursday. bring cash, leave your morals
lee.label: Go to Big Lee's card night

lee.text: need a driver for a 'quick job'. nothing dodgy. it's a bit dodgy
lee.label: Ride along with Lee
lee.result: The 'job' is collecting 300 garden gnomes from a man in a lay-by. You don't ask. You really don't ask.

lee.text: car boot sale sunday. i'm selling. you're the celebrity draw
lee.label: Help at the car boot sale
lee.result: You sign 40 things, including a toaster. Lee makes £600. You get a bacon roll.

lee.text: snooker at the club. i'll go easy on you. i won't
lee.label: Play snooker with Lee
lee.result: Lee clears the table twice while eating a pasty. You pot the white four times.

lee.text: got tickets to the boxing. ringside. don't ask how
lee.label: Go to the boxing
lee.result: Ringside, yes. Behind a pillar, also yes. You still get on the telly.

ty.text: need you in a music video bro. you just stand there looking expensive
ty.label: Be in Ty's music video
ty.result: You stand by a hired Lamborghini for three hours. Ty's track gets 800 views. 700 are you.

ty.text: trying a new challenge for the channel, it involves crossbar shots and a goat
ty.label: Do Ty's crossbar challenge
ty.result: You hit the bar nine times. The goat hits Ty once. The video does numbers.

ty.text: podcast ep 4. topic: are footballers just athletes with haircuts. you're the guest
ty.label: Go on Ty's podcast
ty.result: Two hours. Three listeners. One of them is Ty's mum, who asks about your diet.

ty.text: open mic tonight, i'm debuting a diss track about pigeons. need hype man
ty.label: Hype Ty at open mic
ty.result: The pigeon diss lands surprisingly well. You shout 'YEAH' at the wrong moments. A star is born, maybe.

ty.text: photoshoot for my clothing brand 'TY-DAL WAVE' you're the model
ty.label: Model for Ty's brand
ty.result: The hoodie says 'TY-DAL WAVE' in letters that run. You look like a soggy flag. Ty is thrilled.

priya.text: Coffee? Also bring your bank statements. Don't make that face.
priya.label: Money chat with Priya
priya.result: Priya finds three subscriptions you didn't know you had. One is for a cheese of the month club.

priya.text: Pub quiz, but a proper one. At the library. There's a raffle.
priya.label: Go to the library quiz
priya.result: You win the raffle: a book token and a tin of travel sweets. Priya wins the quiz. She's insufferable about it.

priya.text: Walk round the park? I'll explain pensions. You'll thank me in 40 years.
priya.label: Walk and talk pensions
priya.result: You understand compound interest for about eleven minutes. It's beautiful while it lasts.

priya.text: My mum's cooking and she's made too much (on purpose). Come for tea.
priya.label: Go for tea at Priya's
priya.result: Priya's mum feeds you until you can't stand. She sends you home with four tubs. You don't need to cook till Thursday.

priya.text: Volunteering at the food bank Saturday. They'd love a famous face. Or any face.
priya.label: Help at the food bank
priya.result: You stack tins for four hours. Nobody takes a photo. That's what makes it nice.

mo.text: free physio session for a case study? I'll only mildly hurt you
mo.label: Be Mo's case study
mo.result: Mo finds a knot in your calf 'the size of a satsuma'. You feel brand new. Your calf feels violated.

mo.text: yoga class. don't laugh. your hamstrings are a disgrace
mo.label: Do yoga with Mo
mo.result: You fall over in a pose called 'the tree'. A pensioner helps you up. You're more flexible, and humbled.

mo.text: park run saturday? it's 5k. it's free. it's character building
mo.label: Do the park run
mo.result: You finish 4th. A 70-year-old in a tutu finishes 3rd. You will be thinking about her for a while.

mo.text: cold water swim at the lake. it's good for inflammation. it's 4 degrees
mo.label: Go wild swimming with Mo
mo.result: You make a noise you've never made before. Afterwards you feel incredible. You'll never do it again.

mo.text: sports science lecture at the uni tonight, you'd find it interesting (you won't)
mo.label: Go to the lecture with Mo
mo.result: You learn about lactic acid. You fall asleep for nine minutes. Mo says you snored 'in a very efficient rhythm'.

jess.text: the youth club's got a match on saturday and the kids want YOU. please. they've made a banner
jess.label: Coach Jess's youth club
jess.result: The banner spells your name wrong. The kids win 3-2. You cry a bit in the car.

jess.text: sponsored silence for the charity, 24 hours. I know. you'll struggle
jess.label: Do the sponsored silence
jess.result: You last 14 hours. You break it to shout at the telly. Still raises £2,400.

jess.text: painting the community centre. bring old clothes and no ego
jess.label: Paint the community centre
jess.result: You paint a wall and most of yourself. A kid asks if you're 'the man off FIFA'. You say yes. He's disappointed.

jess.text: litter pick on the estate sunday morning. we start at 8. that's not a typo
jess.label: Join the litter pick
jess.result: You find a shopping trolley, a garden gnome and somebody's dentures. Jess finds a fiver and gives it to charity.

jess.text: quiz night fundraiser. you're the guest question master. no swearing this time
jess.label: Host the fundraiser quiz
jess.result: Only two swears. A record. The night raises £900 for new goalposts.

stan.text: Fancy a round of golf, son? I'll give you 20 shots. You'll need them.
stan.label: Play golf with Stan
stan.result: Stan, 81, beats you by nine shots while telling a story about a mud bath at Halifax in 1974.

stan.text: Come and watch the Sunday league with me. Proper football. Proper mud.
stan.label: Watch Sunday league with Stan
stan.result: Stan heckles the referee for 90 minutes. The referee is his nephew. You learn a lot.

stan.text: Allotment needs digging. I'll pay you in rhubarb.
stan.label: Dig Stan's allotment
stan.result: You dig for three hours. Stan supervises from a deckchair. You go home with rhubarb and a sense of purpose.

stan.text: Old players' reunion dinner Friday. They'd like to meet a young 'un. Wear a tie.
stan.label: Go to the old players' dinner
stan.result: Twelve old pros tell you the game's gone soft. Then they all ask for selfies.

stan.text: Dominoes at the club, son. Bring change for the machine.
stan.label: Play dominoes with Stan
stan.result: You lose £3.40 and gain a nickname: 'Fumbles'. Stan says it's a term of endearment.

mum.text: Sunday roast at mine, love. I've done Yorkshires. Bring a pudding (shop-bought is fine, I won't say anything)
mum.label: Go to Mum's for a roast
mum.result: Mum says nothing about the shop-bought pudding. Loudly.

mum.text: Auntie Pat's 60th on Saturday. She's asked for you specifically. Don't make me beg
mum.label: Go to Auntie Pat's 60th
mum.result: Auntie Pat tells everyone you used to wet the bed. Then she cries and says she's proud of you.

mum.text: Can you help me with the new telly? It's asking for a password and I've tried 'password'
mum.label: Fix Mum's telly
mum.result: The password was 'password1'. Mum calls you a genius. You stay for tea.

mum.text: Garden centre trip? There's a café. They do a scone the size of your head
mum.label: Go to the garden centre
mum.result: The scone really is the size of your head. Mum buys a gnome that looks like your Grandad.

mum.text: Your old school's asked if you'd do an assembly. I've said yes. Sorry
mum.label: Do the school assembly
mum.result: Your old PE teacher introduces you as 'the lad who couldn't climb the rope'. The kids go wild anyway.

mum.text: Fancy a walk up the hill like we used to? I'll bring the flask
mum.label: Walk up the hill with Mum
mum.result: Mum stops at every bench. You talk about everything. Best afternoon in ages.

mum.text: Bingo Thursday! Your Gran's coming. Wear something nice
mum.label: Go to bingo
mum.result: Gran wins £40 and accuses the caller of fixing it in her favour, then keeps the money.

gran.text: Poker at mine tonight pet. 2p a hand. Bring biscuits and your A game
gran.label: Play poker at Gran's

gran.text: Doris from bridge club is doing poker Thursday. I've told her you're useless. Prove me right
gran.label: Play poker with Gran and Doris

gran.text: Take me to the bookies love, my hip's playing up and Gary behind the counter fancies me
gran.label: Take Gran to the bookies
gran.result: Gran puts a fiver on a horse called Gran's Revenge. It wins. She buys everyone a Twix.

gran.text: Come round and help me with my phone. It keeps saying I've got 'storage'
gran.label: Sort Gran's phone
gran.result: Gran has 14,000 photos of her own thumb. You delete them. She's devastated.

gran.text: Tea dance at the town hall Saturday. I need a partner who won't tread on me. You'll have to do
gran.label: Take Gran to the tea dance
gran.result: You tread on her four times. She says Ronald from 1962 was worse. High praise.

squad.text: {a}: golf day tuesday lads, gaffer's coming so behave
squad.label: Go to the squad golf day
squad.result: You hit the gaffer's buggy with a five iron. He laughs. It's a worrying laugh.

squad.text: {a}: team meal at the Italian thursday, captain's paying (he doesn't know yet)
squad.label: Go to the team meal
squad.result: The captain finds out at the bill. He takes it well. He takes it very badly.

squad.text: {a}: hospital visit with the club charity on wednesday, few of us going. you in?
squad.label: Do the hospital visit
squad.result: A seven-year-old asks why you missed that sitter. You have no answer. She gives you a sticker anyway.

squad.text: {a}: extra shooting practice after training, me, you and the bag of balls
squad.label: Do extra shooting practice
squad.result: Two hours of finishing. The gaffer watches from his office window. He says nothing. He's noticed.

squad.text: {a}: go-karting saturday?? loser does the fines kitty for a month
squad.label: Go go-karting
squad.result: You come second. {a} comes last after crashing into a hay bale. He has the fines kitty now. God help us.

squad.text: {a}: who's coming to the darts? i've got a table. it's next to the toilets
squad.label: Go to the darts
squad.result: You get on the big screen holding a sign that says '180 OR I'M MOVING CLUBS'. Fans love it.

squad.text: {a}: fifa tournament at mine, winner gets bragging rights and my nan's lasagne
squad.label: Go to the FIFA tournament
squad.result: You lose in the semis playing as yourself. Your own card lets you down. The lasagne is elite.

squad.text: {a}: school visit thursday for the club, they want a 'role model'. we're all they've got
squad.label: Do the school visit
squad.result: A kid asks how much you earn. Another asks if you've met a famous person. You say 'not really'. Brutal.
